dedupe_keys.name: oil spill release amount text extraction code and source tables

description: The oil-spill incident team publishes Jupyter notebooks and supporting tables used to infer actual release amounts from incident text. Coverage follows the included global incident reports. The Figshare package includes source incident CSV and Excel files, manually reviewed candidate amounts and notebooks for extraction and evaluation. It is free under CC BY 4.0. The workflow can help turn unstructured spill reports into quantitative event inputs for hazard-exposure simulations. No directly related catalogue record was identified. A caveat is that a phrase in an incident update may refer to a potential, preliminary or corrected amount, not the final release. Manual adjudication and source provenance remain necessary before the output is used as ground truth. The public description and file manifest were checked, but the notebooks, text contents and extraction accuracy were not downloaded or tested. The final enhanced spill table is a separate deposit assessed as data.
